Things to do in Toronto

First visit or fifth, these are the places everyone wants to see. A Toronto tour is the easy way to fit several into one trip.

CN Tower and skyline

Toronto's most famous view, best seen from the waterfront or the Toronto Islands.

St. Lawrence Market

A historic food market in downtown Toronto, great for lunch.

Royal Ontario Museum

A major museum with striking architecture on Bloor Street.

Hockey Hall of Fame

A hockey history landmark in a historic downtown building.

Ripley's Aquarium of Canada

A family favourite aquarium near the CN Tower.

Roundhouse Park

Heritage railway site near the waterfront, home to the Toronto Railway Museum.

Nathan Phillips Square

Home of the colourful TORONTO sign and a top photo spot.

Toronto Islands

Car-free parks and some of the best skyline views in the city.

Theatre District

Historic theatres and live shows around King Street.

Things to do in Toronto: a first-timer's guideNovember 3, 2026

Toronto rewards visitors who mix landmarks with neighbourhoods. Start with the waterfront and the CN Tower area, then add St. Lawrence Market for food and Kensington Market for a more local feel. Save the Distillery District for an evening, when the lights and cafes are at their best. A guided city tour is the fastest way to see how these areas connect, so you can choose where to spend more time.

Book a Toronto tour

Toronto in winter: markets, lights and festive funNovember 2, 2026

Winter is a good time to see Toronto. The Distillery District's winter market and the city's seasonal lights give you reasons to head out after dark, and indoor attractions keep cold days easy. Dress in layers, wear warm footwear, and book early because winter events are popular. Our winter market shuttle and winter lights scavenger hunt by bus are built for this season.

Book a Toronto tour

What to expect on a small-group Toronto city tourOctober 28, 2026

A small-group city tour gives you a local guide, a clear route and the chance to ask questions. It is ideal on your first day: you see the highlights, learn the layout of the city and pick the places you want to return to. Wear comfortable shoes, bring water and dress for the weather.

Book a Toronto tour

How to plan 3 days in TorontoOctober 20, 2026

Day one: a city tour, the waterfront and an evening view of the skyline. Day two: St. Lawrence Market, Kensington Market and Chinatown. Day three: the Toronto Islands or a day trip to Niagara Falls. Leave space for food, which is half the reason to visit.

Book a Toronto tour

Best time to visit TorontoOctober 10, 2026

Summer is lively with festivals and the Toronto Islands. Autumn is mild with colourful foliage. Winter brings markets and lights. Spring is a quieter shoulder season. Whatever the month, check the forecast and pack for changing weather.

Toronto tours: frequently asked questions

What are the best tours in Toronto?

Our Toronto tours include a small-group city tour, a Distillery District winter market shuttle and a winter lights scavenger hunt by bus. The small-group city tour is the best starting point for first-time visitors.

What is the best Toronto city tour for first-time visitors?

The From Toronto: Small Group City Tour is designed to show you the city's main sights with a local guide, so you can get oriented and plan the rest of your stay.

What is a Toronto scavenger hunt tour?

It is a tour where you solve clues and complete challenges along the route. Our Winter Lights and Scavenger Hunt by Bus combines Toronto's winter lights with a scavenger hunt.

What seasonal tours do you offer in Toronto?

Right now we offer winter experiences: the Distillery District Winter Market Shuttle and the Winter Lights and Scavenger Hunt by Bus. Check back for spring, summer and autumn tours.

Backstreets Back is a Toronto city tour themed around the Backstreet Boys concerts in Toronto, made for fans who want to make a weekend of it. It is coming soon; join the list for first access.

Is the Backstreets Back tour affiliated with the Backstreet Boys?

No. It is an independent, fan-themed city tour and is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by the Backstreet Boys or their management.

Are your tours good for friend groups, birthdays and bachelorette parties?

Yes. Scavenger hunts and themed city tours work well for groups. Email reservations@travaza.com with your date and group size.

What are the best Toronto tours for millennials and Gen Z?

Scavenger hunts, themed city tours, winter lights and photo-friendly stops are popular with younger travellers. Try our Winter Lights and Scavenger Hunt by Bus, and watch for Backstreets Back.

What are the best Instagram spots in Toronto?

Popular photo spots include the TORONTO sign at Nathan Phillips Square, the skyline from the Toronto Islands, St. Lawrence Market and the colourful Distillery District.

How do I find a Toronto tour near me?

All our tours start in Toronto. Choose a tour on this page and your confirmation email will show the meeting point.

What are the best things to do in Toronto?

Popular things to do in Toronto include a guided city tour, the CN Tower, St. Lawrence Market, Kensington Market, the Distillery District, the Toronto Islands and the waterfront. A city tour is a good way to see several of these in one outing.

What are the best things to do in Toronto in winter?

Visit the Distillery District winter market, see the city's winter lights, skate outdoors and enjoy indoor attractions and food markets. Our Winter Market Shuttle and Winter Lights Scavenger Hunt by Bus are designed for the season.

How do I book a Toronto tour with Travaza?

Is the Toronto Distillery Winter Market Shuttle worth it?

If you want to enjoy the winter market without planning transit or parking, a shuttle keeps it simple. Check the tour page for the current dates and times.

What is the Winter Lights and Scavenger Hunt by Bus?

It is a bus experience that shows you Toronto's winter lights and includes a scavenger hunt. It suits couples, friends and families looking for a fun evening activity.

Are Toronto tours good for families with kids?

Many are. The winter lights scavenger hunt is especially family-friendly. Tell us your children's ages when you book and we will help you choose.

How long are the tours?

Durations differ by tour and season. The exact length is shown on each tour's booking page after you click Book now.

Where do the tours start and finish?

Meeting or pickup details are shown at booking and in your confirmation email. If you are unsure, contact reservations@travaza.com.

How much do Toronto tours cost?

Prices depend on the tour, date and number of guests. Click Book now to see current pricing and availability.

Can I book a private Toronto tour or a group tour?

Contact reservations@travaza.com with your date, group size and interests, and we will tell you what is possible.

When is the best time to visit Toronto?

Late spring to early autumn is the mildest for walking and the Toronto Islands. Winter is the season for markets, lights and indoor attractions.

How many days do I need in Toronto?

Three days is enough for the main sights: one day downtown and the waterfront, one for neighbourhoods and markets, and one for the Toronto Islands or a day trip.

Can I visit Niagara Falls from Toronto?

Yes, Niagara Falls is a popular day trip from Toronto, roughly 130 km away. Contact us to ask about options.

What should I wear on a Toronto tour?

Dress for the weather and wear comfortable shoes. In winter, bring a warm coat, hat, gloves and boots.

Are the tours accessible?
